sentences.text: Petitioners have initiated the contempt proceedings against the respondent for non-compliance of the judgment/order dated 04.05.2018 passed by this Court in OWP No.1811/2017, wherein a direction was issued to the respondents to take all legal steps including formal acquisition of the land of the petitioners and pay them compensation at the market rate without any further delay and in any case within six months.
02. Statement of facts/compliance report has been filed by the respondent.

As per para 4 of the statement of facts, the respondent has approved release of compensation amount to the tune of Rs.15,77000/- in favour of the petitioners for the land measuring 01K-02M falling under survey Nos.1433 & 1434 acquired for construction of Bus Stand Verinag, Tehsil Shahabad Bala District Anantnag, by virtue of notification under Section 4 of the State Land Acquisition Act dated 22.05.2007 followed by a corrigendum dated 18.07.2013.

The further stand taken by the respondent is that the compensation has been assessed as per the market rate of 2018 issued by this office vide Notification 01 of 2018 dated 02.04.2014 in conformity with the direction passed by this Court Makhan Lal Koul And Others vs Mohd. Yunis Malik on 15 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8102296/
1 (supra).

entities.text: Makhan Lal Koul And Others vs Mohd. Yunis Malik
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The further stand taken by the respondent that the office of the District Magistrate,
Anantnag has accordingly credited the aforesaid amount in the form of demand draft and the Relief & Rehabilitation Commissioner (Migrants) to disburse the same to the rightful owner after proper identification.
03. In view of the above, order dated 04.05.2018 stands complied with.
As such, nothing survives for consideration in this contempt petition.
Accordingly, proceedings in this contempt petition are closed.
(WASIM SADIQ NARGAL) JUDGE JAMMU 15.11.2023 Shammi Makhan Lal Koul And Others vs Mohd. Yunis Malik on 15 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8102296/

opennyai_summary.facts:
Petitioners have initiated the contempt proceedings against the respondent for non-compliance of the judgment/order dated 04.05.2018 passed by this Court in OWP No.1811/2017, wherein a direction was issued to the respondents to take all legal steps including formal acquisition of the land of the petitioners and pay them compensation at the market rate without any further delay and in any case within six months.
As per para 4 of the statement of facts, the respondent has approved release of compensation amount to the tune of Rs.15,77000/- in favour of the petitioners for the land measuring 01K-02M falling under survey Nos.1433 & 1434 acquired for construction of Bus Stand Verinag, Tehsil Shahabad Bala District Anantnag, by virtue of notification under Section 4 of the State Land Acquisition Act dated 22.05.2007 followed by a corrigendum dated 18.07.2013.
The further stand taken by the respondent is that the compensation has been assessed as per the market rate of 2018 issued by this office vide Notification 01 of 2018 dated 02.04.2014 in conformity with the direction passed by this Court Makhan Lal Koul And Others vs Mohd. Yunis Malik on 15 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8102296/
1 (supra).
The further stand taken by the respondent that the office of the District Magistrate,
Anantnag has accordingly credited the aforesaid amount in the form of demand draft and the Relief & Rehabilitation Commissioner (Migrants) to disburse the same to the rightful owner after proper identification.
